description.zh: kill 进程名或 PID：列出进程，Enter 结束，Ctrl+Enter 连同子进程
description.en: kill <name or PID>: lists processes; Enter ends one, Ctrl+Enter with its children

description.zh: 按名字或 PID 找到进程，结束它
description.en: Find a process by name or PID and end it

hint.zh: 进程名或 PID；留空列出占内存最多的
hint.en: a process name or PID; empty lists the biggest

ai.description: List running processes whose name contains the query (or whose PID equals it): name, PID, memory in MB and the executable's path. The query may be empty for the biggest ones.

hint.zh: svchost、csrss 这类没有窗口的 Windows 进程
hint.en: svchost, csrss and other windowless Windows processes
